company_description: Lagardere SA engages in content publishing, production, and broadcasting of media, entertainment, and the distribution of products and services in France, the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, Spain, Latin America, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Lagardère Publishing, Lagardère Travel Retail, and Lagardère Live. The Lagardère Publishing segment includes book publishing, covering areas, such as education, general literature, illustrated books, textbooks, extra-curricular works, partworks, dictionaries, children and young adult titles, paperbacks, travel guides, board games, and premium stationery in English, French, and Spanish. The Lagardère Travel Retail segment is involved in retail activities in transit areas and concessions in travel essentials, duty free and fashion, and food services. It operates stores under its own international brands, including Relay, Hubiz, 1Minute, Hub Convenience, Discover, Tech2go, Aelia Duty Free, The Fashion Gallery, The Fashion Place, Eye Love, Bread&Co., So! Coffee, Trib's, Vino Volo, FIX, Beercode, Natoo, and Marché, as well as local identity store names such as Bottega dei Sapori, The Belgian Chocolate House, Sa

description.long_fr: Lagardère est un groupe de médias et de services structuré en deux pôles : Lagardère Publishing (édition de livres via Hachette Livre, premier éditeur en France et au Royaume-Uni) et Lagardère Travel Retail (concessions de boutiques duty free et de presse dans les aéroports et gares). Contrôlé majoritairement par Vivendi (groupe Bolloré).
description.long_en: Lagardère is a media and services group structured around two pillars: Lagardère Publishing (book publishing through Hachette Livre, leading publisher in France and the UK) and Lagardère Travel Retail (duty-free and press concessions in airports and stations). Majority controlled by Vivendi (Bolloré group).
description.long_de: Lagardère ist ein Medien‑ und Dienstleistungskonzern, der in zwei Geschäftsbereiche gegliedert ist: Lagardère Publishing (Buchverlag über Hachette Livre, führender Verlag in Frankreich und im Vereinigten Königreich) und Lagardère Travel Retail (Duty‑Free‑ und Pressegeschäfte in Flughäfen und Bahnhöfen). Der Konzern befindet sich mehrheitlich im Besitz von Vivendi (Bolloré‑Gruppe).
